what: Visual realism step on the simulated twin: OpenFreeMap street base map on every map page, a labelled satellite picture, roads at lane width with lane lines, more vehicle paint colours, automatic start. Driven in headless Chrome on 2026-10-05.
label: SIMULATED: the traffic is generated, uncalibrated demand. Nothing here is a measurement of traffic.
command: cd frontend && npm run build; python -m uvicorn app.main:app --app-dir backend --host 127.0.0.1 --port 8011; a DevTools script opened each page, pressed the buttons named below and saved the screenshots

satellite.source: Sentinel-2 cloudless 2016 by EOX, CC BY 4.0
satellite.what_it_is: a composite of images captured during 2016 at 10 m per pixel; not one date, not live; requested up to zoom 14 and stretched beyond, not sharpened
note_on_the_map: satellite image: composite of 2016 captures at 10 m per pixel, not live
satellite.credit_on_the_map: Sentinel-2 cloudless by EOX IT Services GmbH (Contains modified Copernicus Sentinel data 2016) | © OpenStreetMap contributors, Overture Maps Foundation | OpenFreeMap © OpenMapTiles Data from OpenStreetMap

roads.width_rule: sum of the section's lane widths in the SUMO network, drawn in metres for the city's latitude
roads.lane_lines: dashed, between lanes of the same section, from zoom 16; drawn from the lane count, not seen in any image

los_angeles: Roads are drawn as wide as their lanes in the SUMO network (lane count × lane width), not at a measured width. The lane count comes from an OpenStreetMap lanes tag for 968 sections and from SUMO's default for the road class for 1682; for 0 it is not recorded which.
dhaka: Roads are drawn as wide as their lanes in the SUMO network (lane count × lane width), not at a measured width. The lane count comes from an OpenStreetMap lanes tag for 0 sections and from SUMO's default for the road class for 0; for 6527 it is not recorded which.

vehicles.legend_line: vehicle colours are decoration and carry no data

autostart_note: Dhaka was opened with the server's last run in the state 'stopped' and started by itself within the 4 seconds before the script's first reading. Los Angeles had already been started by an earlier page visit in the same script. Sylhet also started by itself (status 'running · simulated second 23' 25 s after opening). After Stop the page stayed stopped and offered the Start button.
legend_position: measured on Sylhet: legend 884-946 px, map credit 970-994 px (950-994 with the satellite credit); they do not overlap
not_checked: a real graphics card (headless Chrome drew with software rendering) and touch devices
the words 'starting the simulation' were never caught on screen by the script
a run reaching its end and starting again (written and unit-tested, not watched for 30 minutes)
the 'Stop it and start <city>' button shown when another city's simulation is running (unit-tested decision, not pressed in a browser)
the base map failing to load (falls back to a plain background in code, not exercised)
the Add-your-city card's map after a search, and every page in Bangla
the Today page has no map, so there was nothing to check there
clicking a vehicle (still never exercised in a browser)
whether a lane count tagged in OpenStreetMap is itself right; 'OpenStreetMap' means only that the way carries a lanes tag
OpenFreeMap serves whatever tile set is current; the map's content is not pinned to a date
